scripts.dev: bun run dev:api & bun run dev:web
scripts.dev:web: bun scripts/select-web-config.ts local && bun --cwd apps/web run dev
scripts.check: bun run check:api && bun run check:web
scripts.test: bun test tests/contracts.market.test.ts tests/api.indices.test.ts tests/api.scheduler-status.test.ts tests/api.routes.test.ts tests/web.market-loaders.test.ts tests/web.status-loaders.test.ts tests/web.api-targets.test.ts
scripts.check:web: bun scripts/select-web-config.ts remote && bun --cwd apps/web run check
scripts.deploy:web: bun scripts/select-web-config.ts remote && bun --cwd apps/web run deploy
